stem.alt: Circuit diagram. A dashed outline encloses a cell and a resistor in series. The circuit also contains a switch, a lamp shown as a crossed circle, and a voltmeter labelled V connected across the lamp.

stem.text: Which statement about the circuit is **not** correct?

A.text: Electromotive force is the energy transferred per unit charge.

B.text: Energy is transferred from chemical potential energy in the cell to other forms when the switch is closed.

C.text: The electromotive force of the cell is greater than the terminal potential difference when the switch is closed.

D.text: When the switch is open, the voltmeter measures the electromotive force of the cell.
